latest.title: AWS KMS Explained: Encryption, Customer Managed Keys and Secure Key Management
latest.description:
Encryption is a fundamental part of securing cloud workloads. AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) helps organizations create and control cryptographic keys used to protect data across AWS services.

This article explains AWS KMS, encryption at rest, encryption in transit, AWS managed keys, customer managed keys, key policies, grants, automatic key rotation, envelope encryption, and practical key-management best practices.

latest.title: Migrating Petabyte-Scale NFS Workloads to Amazon EFS: A Field Runbook
latest.description: Moving a large, latency-sensitive NFS workload from on-premises to the cloud is one of those projects where the architecture diagram is the easy part. The hard part is everything the diagram doesn't show: how your working set interacts with a distributed cache, what happens to your bill while data transits storage tiers, and whether you can get the EC2 capacity you need on the day it matters most.

latest.title: AWS Student Rewards: A Practical Starting Guide for Students Building a Cloud Career ☁️🧑🏻‍💻
latest.description: A practical guide for university students starting with AWS Student Rewards. Learn how student verification, AWS Builder Center badges, 12 months of Skill Builder Premium, AWS Credits, and the Foundational Certification exam voucher work together. It also covers what to do when verification fails, how to participate meaningfully, and how to turn the rewards into hands-on cloud skills, projects, certification preparation, and stronger career value without chasing badges alone.
